title: Pinned contract matrix and conformance test plan for prompt/output/parameter preservation
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a machine-readable compatibility contract (contract matrix) and an automated conformance test plan for all pinned model releases. The contract must explicitly enumerate allowed prompt shapes, structured-output schemas, sampling/temperature behaviors, parameter defaults, KV-cache incompatibilities, and expected failure modes. Deliverables: contract JSON schema published to the model catalog, a conformance test harness that runs on CI and at rollout, and a guide for SDK/Console teams to surface contract violations to customers.
acceptance_criteria: Contract matrix schema (JSON Schema) covering prompt format, argument types, output JSON schemas, and runtime parameters is approved and published in the model catalog.
Conformance test harness implemented and added to the model onboarding CI job; tests pass for current pinned models.
Golden prompt suite and expected output signatures committed to the repo and used as regression artifacts.
Rollout gating: automated check blocks canary->prod promotion if conformance score drops > 2% or any critical contract checks fail.
Console displays contract version and a human-readable compatibility summary on model pages.
notes_and_updates: 2025-02-10 - Kickoff: scoped matrix dimensions (prompt shape, structured outputs, sampling params, KV cache layout). Owner: Miguel.
2025-02-12 - Decision: use JSON Schema draft-07 for contract artifacts to align with SDK validation libraries. (Priya, Miguel)
2025-02-13 - Trade-off: full byte-level KV cache compatibility checking is expensive; we will start with semantic KV cache contract (cache key shape + TTL expectations) and add binary checks later.
2025-02-14 - Design review feedback from Console team: include user-visible summary and machine-readable severity levels for each contract rule. Updated contract schema to add 'severity' field.

2025-02-16 - Implementation: added initial conformance harness (tests/conformance_runner.py) and golden prompts (tests/golden_prompts.jsonl). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboarding/pull/6123

2025-02-18 - Security: reviewed for PII handling in golden prompts; removed sensitive examples and added synthetic data guideline. Note from Security: coordinate with privacy team before including any customer-derived prompts.
2025-02-19 - Performance note: running the full conformance suite adds ~12 minutes to onboarding CI for large models; added an opt-in fast-path for smoke checks to be used in quick canaries.
2025-02-20 - Next: link contract artifacts to model catalog page and add webhook that triggers conformance re-check on model binary changes.
implementation_notes: Use language-agnostic JSON Schema for contract exchange between catalog, SDKs, and conformance harness.
Provide canonical serializer/deserializer examples in Python and Node to avoid subtle prompt encoding regressions.
Conformance scoring: critical failures (schema mismatch, missing required fields) -> fail; non-critical (minor tokenization drift) -> warn and surface in rollout dashboard.
Rollout policy will include automatic fallback to previous pinned variant if critical contract checks fail in canary.
Plan to add quantization/bit-level compatibility checks as a separate workstream (lower priority) because of runtime variability across hardware.
